shadowSentences: She loves to read every evening.
I often cook dinner for my family.
He enjoys hiking in the mountains every weekend.
They traveled to Japan last summer for vacation.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes in watercolors.
We always celebrate birthdays with a big party at home.
I usually go jogging in the park early in the morning.
Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.
Visiting new cities helps me learn about different cultures and cuisines.
Taking care of a pet teaches responsibility and compassion in life.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your last travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face while planning that trip?
Q3: How important is travel to you in your life?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about healthy eating.
questions: Q1: What does a typical meal look like for you?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: In your opinion, why is healthy eating important?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone wanting to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly habits.
questions: Q1: What eco-friendly practices do you follow at home?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in adopting more sustainable habits?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of environmental protection?
Q4: What suggestions would you give to someone wanting to be more eco-conscious?
